author: king process
description:
Man Risks His Life Braving Tens of Thousands of Bees to Harvest a Giant Hive!

Hello, this is King Process.

In this video, we follow a Vietnamese man who climbs high into the trees to harvest wild honey while battling cancer.

A giant honeycomb hangs beneath a branch, surrounded by a dense swarm of bees. He steadies himself in the tree and cuts through the honeycomb with a knife. Even watching him work up close is nerve-racking.

Watch as he goes about his work while living with cancer, and see how wild honey is harvested high in the jungle trees.
